text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way back from an outing 
with Bamboo Memory...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mm? Isn't that person over there from 
Oguri-senpai's class—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! Senpai! Those back alleys are 
full of shady characters, it's dangerous 
down there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who called out to her seemed 
to be an acquaintance. Her hair was 
disheveled, her uniform all rumpled, and 
she looked thoroughly pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, Senpai, you're all beat up!! 
Did you get jumped by some shady thugs and 
dragged into a back alley or something!?

text_block_list.name: Worn-out? Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it! I went to the back 
alley on my own—wait, tattered?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Because looking like that, you look like 
you just got caught up in some crazy 
incident!

text_block_list.name: Worn-out? Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
N-No way!? This is... This is just a 
makeover, I sweaaaarrr!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. You changed your hair and outfit 
because you wanted to change yourself, 
huh?”

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I got so sick of my plain, boring 
self. So I decided to become the complete 
opposite—a flashy, bad-girl Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No, that wasn't proper at all, you know!? 
In the first place, being sloppy is no 
good! It even violates public morals, you 
know!
choice_data_list: Why do you want to change so badly?
Why do you want to change so badly?

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I wanted to become an amazing 
Umamusume too... just like the shining 
stars in our class...

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has such a strong presence, 
they're in high demand for events, and 
they shine just like idols...

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She has so many fans, including lots of 
die-hard supporters who traveled all the 
way from her hometown――

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
But I barely have any fans, and no matter 
how much time passes, I'm stuck as a side 
character...

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's because I'm so plain and 
unremarkable...! If I don't give myself a 
total makeover and change completely, I'll 
never get to be the star of the show, will 
I...?!
choice_data_list:
...You don't need to put yourself down 
that much.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Plus, I think Oguri-senpai 
and the others' popularity isn't about 
looks, but because everyone's captivated 
by their running!

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-I trained desperately too, you know! No 
matter how hard I try, I can't run like 
you! A plain girl like me just doesn't 
have any talent!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Still... Senpai, you probably already know 
deep down, right? That a makeover alone 
won't make you shine.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm chasing after Oguri-senpai myself, 
so I totally get how dazzling the seniors 
look!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Still! That's exactly why you can't give 
up on running! You came to Tracen because 
you wanted to run too, right, Senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text: “...That might be true, but...”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I know you can shine even brighter, 
Senpai! Let's discover all the amazing 
things about you together...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“—And with that, let's spark up some 
passionate training!! Pure endurance! Park 
running, let's go!!”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa, haa... Senpai, your form hasn't 
broken down at all! It's as 
textbook-perfect as it gets!"

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...? Isn't it too plain and 
unremarkable...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's a refined run built on mastering 
the absolute basics! It's definitely not 
something anyone can just pull off!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa, haah... That's the end of it! 
Though Senpai, your pace didn't break down 
at all. Do you still have more in the 
tank?"

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa, haa... Yeah, I'm okay. Taking it 
slow and steady like this is what I'm used 
to, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Your stamina is off the charts! Keeping up 
with this fiery training is seriously 
impressive! How is that plain at all?!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was some amazing running, young 
ladies! Working so hard lap after lap, 
you're so admirable~. If you ever enter a 
race, I'll go cheer for ya!

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah, um... Thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Come on! You should have way more 
confidence in yourself, Senpai! Right, 
Trainer-san?
choice_data_list:
Let's keep working hard and shine even 
brighter.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Right? Even Trainer, who's seen plenty of 
strong and sparkling Umamusume, says so!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"The two of us will personally guarantee 
that your radiance won't go unnoticed, 
Senpai!!"

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Fufufu! That's... very reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to you, my eyes have been 
opened. I was so happy that Bamboo-chan 
trained with me and pointed out my strong 
points...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Even Oguri-senpai and the 
others weren't popular right from the very 
start!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"You've got your own pace, Senpai! If more 
people keep supporting you like this, 
you'll definitely become your ideal self 
one day!!"

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Yeah, that's right! I'll keep 
steady at my own pace...!”

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to you, my eyes have been 
opened. I was so happy that Bamboo-chan 
trained with me and pointed out my strong 
points...

text_block_list.name: Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep doing my best in training! So 
that one day I can take center stage and 
shine... I'm going to polish my very own 
sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I think that's great!! I'm rooting for 
you, Senpai!!
